text:
deploy-bot: staged rollout started for v2026.03.21 -> 10% traffic (canary group). change window OK. observability checks enabled. watch latency / errors.
marco: pinging @dana @rachel — start of canary, please call stop/go on any abnormal signal.
rachel: heads up, seeing an oddball in eu-west1 95th latency spikes — was ~180ms now 430ms over last 3 mins :eyes:
marco: hold on. is this across models/routes or a specific route?
rachel: looks concentrated on `/v1/generate` to model xlarge-quant. error rate stable but tail latency + queue depth up on pods in eu-west1. query I ran: ```sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{le="0.5",route="/v1/generate",region="eu-west1"}[5m])) by (le)```
dana: thanks — can we reduce traffic to 2% while we triage? prefer to avoid full rollback until we confirm cause.
sre-oncall: infra check started. autoscaler saw surge and spun up 2 extra nodes, but k8s pod restarts ~4 in last 6m. pulling kube logs now.
deploy-bot: traffic adjustment: shifting canary -> 2% (from 10%) as requested by marco.
marco: thanks deploy-bot. recording decision: pause at 2%, pin canary to v2026.03.21 for investigation, no global cutover.
rachel: collecting more traces — adding a flag to trace sampling for eu-west1 for next 5m. ETA 2m.
dana: if tail latency persists after reducing traffic, propose region pin: route eu-west1 -> fallback model v2026.03.19 to avoid user impact. any objections?
sre-oncall: logs show OOM kills on one node (container runtime), kernel OOM invoked. likely memory regressed after quantization tweak in v2026.03.21.
marco: good catch. Do we have a low-effort revert plan?
dana: yes — two options: 1) region-level route pin to v2026.03.19 (fast, limited blast radius) 2) full rollback of canary and abort rollout (slower). leaning 1.
rachel: agree with 1. will validate that v2026.03.19 satisfies correctness for eu-west1.
sre-oncall: preparing pin rule, will apply in 90s and monitor pod restarts.
deploy-bot: note: applying route override for region=eu-west1 -> model v2026.03.19 now.
marco: once pin is applied, we keep canary at 2% in other regions and re-evaluate after 15 min. if stable, we can re-quant and retry.
dana: creating incident ticket and adding rollback/regression tags. also will open a small follow-up with the quant team to revert the memory change.
rachel: trace sampling confirms requests hitting the pinned fallback now and 95th latency reduced to 170ms in eu-west1. monitoring looks good. :thumbsup:
marco: OK consensus: STOP full rollout. HOLD at 2%, pinned eu-west1 to previous model, incident created, tracing + logs preserved. We'll reconvene in 15m or sooner if new signal.
deploy-bot: staged rollout paused per consensus (marco). traffic remains at 2%. automated alerts silenced for this canary group until next update.
marco: thanks everyone. I'll post a short deploy note for product and CS. keep this thread for updates only.
